source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As the first battle round starts, pick one Benediction of the Omnissiah; it applies to your **CULT MECHANICUS** units until the battle ends:

- **PANEGYRIC PROCESSION**: each ranged attack by a **CULT MECHANICUS** model of yours against a target within half range improves its Armour Penetration by 1.
- **CITATION IN SAVAGERY**: when a **CULT MECHANICUS** unit of yours is picked to fight after completing a **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** earlier in the turn, its models' melee weapons get +1 Strength and +1 Attacks until the phase ends.
